create_metrics_endpoint: create a prometheus metrics endpoint that updates queue jobs, worker size, cache, and disk usage metrics
create_prometheus_metrics_response: create an async endpoint that returns the latest prometheus metrics content with proper content type headers
update_queue_jobs_total: update the prometheus metric tracking the total number of jobs in the queue
update_worker_size_jobs_count: update the prometheus metric tracking the number of jobs per worker size
update_responses_in_cache_total: update the prometheus metric tracking the total number of responses stored in cache
